text: こんな　ところで　さわいで　おこられちゃう　かな？

structure.jp: こんな　ところで　さわいで
structure.en: making a racket in a place like this

structure.jp: おこられちゃう　かな？
structure.en: I wonder if I'll get scolded?

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says something ends up happening, often something unwanted. おこられちゃう = 'end up getting scolded'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られ inside this verb says the action is done to the speaker by someone else. おこられちゃう = 'get scolded'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.span: おこられちゃう　かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', said half to yourself. おこられちゃう　かな = 'I wonder if I'll get scolded'.
